title: Bark Voice-Preset Experiment Brief: Cue Presence vs. Absence
purpose: A minimal, reproducible experiment brief for testing whether Bark's documented sound cues ([sighs], [clears throat]) meaningfully alter perceived prosody compared to plain text — holding speaker preset, script content, and model size constant. Designed so any practitioner can run it locally and log falsifiable observations.
